suites.purpose: Paired exo and baseline cells on the value, safe and git tasks: does exo pass tasks the stock session fails, at what cost.
suites.basis: The value reports start the baseline at 0 of 5 and require exo at 3 of 5 (results/2026-10-06-value-hard.md); a hill, not a guard.

suites.purpose: Model and effort sweep over review, plan and whole-flow cells: seeded defects found, false alarms, flow cost.
suites.basis: Seeded-defect find rates and flow costs are compared across arms and keep moving (results/2026-10-10-sweep.md, 2026-10-26-flow-fold-sweep.md); no near-100% pass rate.

suites.purpose: One fixed plan built under the old and the new gates: what the gates cost for the same result.
suites.basis: A cost comparison between two versions with a fixture that changes per goal (results/2026-09-28-lean.md, 2026-10-20-lean-lead-tool-pool.md); the target is a lower number, not a held pass rate.

suites.purpose: Seeded review defects fixed after one repair round.
suites.basis: benchmarks/review-replay/baseline.json records fixedAfterOneRepair between 0.33 and 1 per fixture.

suites.purpose: Does the right skill load for a prompt, and no skill for a prompt that needs none.
suites.basis: Held-out recall in results/routing.json is 0.67 to 1 per skill (build 0.73, edit-skills 0.67); descriptions are tuned against it.

suites.purpose: Does exo:locate-code report the files a brief needs.
suites.basis: Recorded recall is 0.83 and report recall 0.92 (results/2026-10-29-locate-haiku.md.json); room to climb.

suites.purpose: Quality of the options and ideas a spec session produces, against cliches and fixed roles.
suites.basis: Scored by judges and compared per variant (results/2026-10-18-ideas-baseline.md and the ideas-spec runs); each variant is an attempt to beat the baseline.

suites.purpose: exo:improve against /goal on real targets and fixtures: score reached per dollar.
suites.basis: Held-out scores are low and moving (results/improve-real.json heldOutScores 0.25 on routing); the comparison is the hill.

suites.purpose: Output length and fact coverage of exo:adhd replies against an "Answer concisely." arm.
suites.basis: adhd/saturated.json lists the cases every arm passes and the screen leaves them out, so the screened cases are the ones still short of 100% (results/2026-10-23-adhd-style.md).

suites.purpose: Skill pressure cases graded against each skill's criteria.md, with and without the skill.
suites.basis: Graded arms land below 100% (with arm 2 of 3, results/2026-10-19-pressure-grade-compression.md); cases are added when a skill fails them.

suites.purpose: Replay of recorded real failures through the model, graded by judges.
suites.basis: replay/cell-stats.mjs keeps a case only while its fail rate is inside BAND 0.1 to 0.9, so every kept case is by construction not near 100%.

suites.purpose: exo:find-cause names the culprit commit on fixed fixtures; catches a change that breaks it.
suites.basis: 145 of 145 recorded cells pass in benchmarks/results/bisect.jsonl, every case and both arms; saturated from the first recorded run.

suites.purpose: exo:review-branch and exo:find-open-points, each dispatched with the Agent tool, return no random marker that only the dispatching session holds.
suites.basis: Must hold in every session, so a single miss is a defect; no recorded run yet, the property is binary. A session fails unless both agents are dispatched; one that times out, hits the budget cap or pastes the marker into a brief is not run.

suites.purpose: Every bisect fixture builds and its contract holds, so a paid bisect run never starts on a broken case.
suites.basis: Deterministic: node benchmarks/bisect.mjs --validate builds each case and exits 1 on a broken contract.

suites.purpose: Every safe task check fails its seed and passes its solution.
suites.basis: Deterministic: the check files run on the committed seed and solution.

suites.purpose: The review-replay and sweep review graders score the good reference as fixed and the bad reference as missed.
suites.basis: Deterministic: reference diffs graded with no model call.

suites.purpose: The adhd fact and length graders pass the reference replies in adhd/references.jsonl.
suites.basis: Deterministic: stored reference replies graded with no model call.

suites.purpose: The flow check passes the reference solution of the flow fixture.
suites.basis: Deterministic: the committed reference graded by the fixture check.

suites.purpose: Every value task check fails its seed and passes its reference solution.
suites.basis: Deterministic: the committed seeds and references graded by the hidden checks.

suites.purpose: Real-session counts: medians and mad of turns, tool calls, dispatches and check runs before and after a change.
suites.basis: Counts come from recorded sessions and move with each change; the target is a lower median, not a held pass rate.

suites.purpose: Tokens per model of one /exo:spec ideate run in full and fast mode on a fixed question.
suites.basis: Token counts come from one recorded run per mode and move with each skill change; the target is a lower count, not a held pass rate.
